extracted.name: Cheesy Buttermilk and Herb Biscuits
extracted.description: Great recipe for Cheesy Buttermilk and Herb Biscuits.
instruction_lines: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
In a mixing bowl combine flour, salt, sugar, baking powder, oregano and black pepper. Whisk until blended.
Add buttermilk, cheese, thyme, rosemary and dill and stir together until dough forms.
Drop dough onto baking sheet in desired size. Take a glass and flour the bottom. Lightly press glass on dough balls and flatten to your liking.
Brush with melted butter and bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.
